title: Swarm evidence block v2
description: The fixed-format footer every subagent must end with. The orchestrator verifies against this instead of re-running the subagent's greps. One line per field, nothing else.

unit.description: Work unit id, matching state.done/remaining, e.g. 'P7'.

commit.description: Commit sha of the unit's work. Empty if PARTIAL/BLOCKED with nothing committed.

files.description: Paths created or modified. Verify with: git show --stat <commit>

checks.description: Commands actually executed, with observed outcome. NEVER list a command you did not run.

result.description: e.g. 'BUILD SUCCESS 1:44' or '78 run / 0 fail / 0 err / 6 skip' or 'exit 128'.

counts.description: run/fail/error/skip when the command is a test run.

gate_met.description: Did the unit's exit gate pass? False means do not mark done.

unverified.description: Anything asserted without direct observation. Must be non-empty rather than quietly assumed.

next.description: The single next action. One line.
